name: Paris IdFM Trains Pack
author: Haeffound
description:
Contains various modern Paris-region rolling stock:

- Metro on rail: MF 01, MF 19
- Metro on rubber tyres: MP 89, MP 14
- Grand Paris Express: MR3V, MR6V
- RER: MI 09, MI 84, MI 20, Z 2N, RER NG
- Transilien: NAT, Francilien
- Tram-trains/Trams: Dualis, Citadis
- Airport APM: VAL

This mod use the beta feature to allow some trains to run on others tracks. See Vehicle description to see what is compatible with what.
Warning, the game currently doesn't allow to use vehicles with more carriage on others stations. I suggest using Francilien station which accept the bigger number of carriage. All RER/transilien stations have the same length and shouldn't interfere.
